title: IDD distribution manifest
description: Pins one source commit and records immutable component identities and usability locations.

schemaVersion.description: Selects the distribution manifest contract version.

sourceCommit.description: Proves identity. Names the full source commit from which every component was built.

components.description: Groups the immutable instructions, skill bundle, and helper components.

instructions.description: Proves identity. Defines the complete installed instruction component rooted at idd-template/.

location.description: Proves usability only. Gives a commit-pinned forge URL whose path names the instructions component root; its commit must equal sourceCommit.

provenance.description: Proves identity. Records how the instruction component bytes were read and their source commit.

kind.description: Records the provenance method as checkout or archive; it does not change build identity.

commit.description: Proves identity. Records the source commit and must equal sourceCommit.

files.description: Proves identity. Lists every instructions file relative to the component root with its SHA-256.

path.description: Proves identity. Names one non-empty relative file path using slash separators without a parent-directory segment.

sha256.description: Proves identity. Gives the lowercase SHA-256 of this file's bytes.

digest.description: Proves identity. Hashes the bytewise path-sorted listing of file SHA-256 values and paths.

skillBundles.description: Groups the two independently identified skill bundle components.

issue-authoring.description: Proves identity. Defines every file in the issue-authoring skill bundle.

location.description: Proves usability only. Gives a commit-pinned forge URL whose path names the issue-authoring bundle root; its commit must equal sourceCommit.

provenance.description: Proves identity. Records how the issue-authoring bundle bytes were read and their source commit.

kind.description: Records the provenance method as checkout or archive; it does not change build identity.

commit.description: Proves identity. Records the source commit and must equal sourceCommit.

files.description: Proves identity. Lists every issue-authoring bundle file relative to the component root with its SHA-256.

path.description: Proves identity. Names one non-empty relative file path using slash separators without a parent-directory segment.

sha256.description: Proves identity. Gives the lowercase SHA-256 of this file's bytes.

digest.description: Proves identity. Hashes the bytewise path-sorted listing of file SHA-256 values and paths.

idd-spec-audit.description: Proves identity. Defines every file in the idd-spec-audit skill bundle.

location.description: Proves usability only. Gives a commit-pinned forge URL whose path names the idd-spec-audit bundle root; its commit must equal sourceCommit.

provenance.description: Proves identity. Records how the idd-spec-audit bundle bytes were read and their source commit.

kind.description: Records the provenance method as checkout or archive; it does not change build identity.

commit.description: Proves identity. Records the source commit and must equal sourceCommit.

files.description: Proves identity. Lists every idd-spec-audit bundle file relative to the component root with its SHA-256.

path.description: Proves identity. Names one non-empty relative file path using slash separators without a parent-directory segment.

sha256.description: Proves identity. Gives the lowercase SHA-256 of this file's bytes.

digest.description: Proves identity. Hashes the bytewise path-sorted listing of file SHA-256 values and paths.

helper.description: Proves identity. Defines the helper entry's runtime closure and invocation.

location.description: Proves usability only. Gives a commit-pinned forge URL for the repository root with no path after the commit; its commit must equal sourceCommit.

provenance.description: Proves identity. Records how the helper component bytes were read and their source commit.

kind.description: Records the provenance method as checkout or archive; it does not change build identity.

commit.description: Proves identity. Records the source commit and must equal sourceCommit.

files.description: Proves identity. Lists the helper entry's runtime closure files relative to the repository root with their SHA-256 values.

path.description: Proves identity. Names one non-empty relative file path using slash separators without a parent-directory segment.

sha256.description: Proves identity. Gives the lowercase SHA-256 of this file's bytes.

digest.description: Proves identity. Hashes the bytewise path-sorted listing of file SHA-256 values and paths.

invocation.description: Proves usability only. Names the executable helper command and its arguments.

command.description: Proves usability only. Names the helper entry and must equal one path in helper.files.

argv.description: Proves usability only. Gives the arguments following the helper command and may be empty.
